title: NemoWorld licensed open assets shortlist
task: Task 09 — licensed open assets shortlist (research only)
scope: Reusable original assets for the existing browser Three.js voxel world (src/voxel-world.js): vegetation, architecture, furniture, UI icons, avatar variants and ambient audio. Licences were read at the rights holder's own repository licence file or own asset/terms page. No asset file, archive, model, texture or sound was downloaded, extracted, converted or integrated by this task.

method.license_rule: An engine or repository licence does not licence its bundled assets. Every candidate was checked against the rights holder's own LICENSE/COPYING/LICENSE.txt in the official repository, or the rights holder's own asset/terms page when no licence file is published. Badges, blog posts, wiki summaries and third-party 'CC0 lists' were never treated as evidence.
method.measurement_rule: Download sizes marked 'HTTP HEAD' were measured with a HEAD request against the publisher's download endpoint on 2026-10-12; nothing was fetched. Page-reported sizes are quoted as reported. Sizes marked 'not published / not measured' were not available on the publisher's page and were not obtained.
method.search_route: WebSearch plus FetchURL against kenney.nl asset pages, kaylousberg.itch.io product pages, the KayKit-Game-Assets GitHub repositories, quaternius.com, opengameart.org item pages, freesound.org per-sound pages, game-icons.net, and raw.githubusercontent.com for Luanti/Terasology/Lucide/Material/Tabler licence files.
method.excluded_by_instruction: Proprietary or decompiled Minecraft content (including Minecraft-replica game projects and decompiler output), Sword Art Online characters, textures, logos and code, and any engine's bundled media taken without its own per-file terms.

field_notes.package_or_version: Exact pack name and the version/date the publisher states, or the repository revision inspected. Absent an archive inspection (no download), version strings are the publisher's own pack versions.
field_notes.visual_fit: Judgement against the world as it actually renders: flat-shaded 1 m cube batches with a muted green/gold/brown palette (src/voxel-world.js LOCAL_COLORS, cubeBatch, tree, house, furniture), not against generic 'looks nice' criteria.
field_notes.license: The licence as stated by the rights holder, verbatim identifier where available.
field_notes.attribution_notice: The credit/notice a distribution would have to carry. 'None required' means the licence imposes no credit obligation, not that provenance should be left unrecorded.
field_notes.modification_permitted: true, false, or "unverified" when no licence text exists to rely on.
field_notes.formats: Only formats the rights holder states. 'not stated' means the publisher page does not list file formats and no archive was opened.
field_notes.dimensions_or_polycounts: Published measurements only. 'not published' means the rights holder does not state them.
field_notes.download_size: Measured or page-reported size of the pack, with the basis.
field_notes.integration_cost: Engineering cost in this codebase, including the verified fact that the vendored renderer bundle assets/vendor/three-voxel.js exports 27 symbols with no GLTFLoader, OBJLoader or TextureLoader, and that no audio playback subsystem exists in app.js or src/.
field_notes.unresolved_rights: Everything still unconfirmed. 'None identified' is used only when the licence text covers the whole pack and the pack was fully described by the publisher.
field_notes.license_verified_from_publisher_file: true when the licence was read from a document published by the rights holder: a LICENSE/COPYING/LICENSE.txt in the official repository, or the rights holder's own asset/terms page. false when only a project-level or engine-level statement exists and no asset-level licence could be read.
field_notes.license_verified_at_url: The exact URL the licence text was read at on 2026-10-12.
field_notes.license_checked: Date of the licence check, in the worktree's local calendar.

excluded_and_rejected.proprietary_or_decompiled_minecraft: Excluded by the task rules and by docs/VOXEL_ENGINE_REUSE.md: Minecraft JARs, decompiled Minecraft code and assets, Minecraft-replica projects (e.g. MineClone/VoxeLibre, MineClone2) and any texture or model that reproduces Minecraft's visual identity. No Mojang asset was opened.
excluded_and_rejected.sword_art_online: Excluded by the task rules: SAO characters, textures, logos, Sword Skill/UI naming and any derived code. Nothing from that franchise was searched for or recorded.
excluded_and_rejected.pixabay_audio: Rejected: pixabay.com/service/license-summary returned HTTP 403 from this environment, so the rights holder's own current terms could not be read, and the Pixabay Content Licence is not CC0 and restricts standalone use of files. Not recorded as a candidate.
excluded_and_rejected.sonniss_gdc_bundle: Rejected: sonniss.com/gameaudiogdc returned HTTP 403 from this environment; the bundle is royalty-free for productions but its terms restrict redistribution of the raw files, and the terms could not be read from here.
excluded_and_rejected.freepd: Rejected: freepd.com announced its closure ('we have officially taken the service offline') and its catalogue is no longer served, so the public-domain statements for those tracks can no longer be verified at the source. LegacyMusic tracks that credit freepd therefore need per-track re-verification.
excluded_and_rejected.zapsplat_and_subscription_libraries: Rejected: subscription or account-bound libraries (ZapSplat, Storyblocks and similar) grant project use without a reusable per-file licence, which does not match this shortlist's verification standard.
excluded_and_rejected.unity_asset_store: Rejected: the Unity Asset Store EULA is a single-entity licence tied to the Unity ecosystem, not a reusable open licence.
excluded_and_rejected.sketchfab_noncommercial: Rejected: 'Voxel Trees + Voxel file' on Sketchfab is CC BY-NC-ND (no commercial use, no derivatives), which fails both the reuse and the modification test.
excluded_and_rejected.paid_tiers_of_otherwise_cc0_packs: Rejected: the paid EXTRA/SOURCE tiers of KayKit packs and the SOURCE kits of Quaternius are separate paid deliveries whose files were not verified here. Only the free tiers are recorded, and only where the rights holder states CC0 for them.
excluded_and_rejected.engine_media_taken_by_default: Rejected: Luanti engine media and Terasology engine/module media are never assumed to share the engine licence. Where no asset-level licence file exists, the pack is recorded as an unresolved right and marked study-only.
excluded_and_rejected.all_in_one_bundles: Rejected: the Kenney All-in-1 bundle and the KayKit Complete bundle would pull in unrelated packs and assets whose terms were not individually checked.

candidates.package_or_version: Kenney Nature Kit, pack version 1.0 (released 2020); archive kenney_nature-kit.zip
candidates.visual_fit: 330 low-poly trees, rocks and foliage. Organic stylised forms with a light, muted palette that is close to the world's greens, but they are not cube geometry: the renderer builds every tree from instanced boxes in src/voxel-world.js tree(). Good fit only if the scene adopts a deliberate low-poly layer; it does not drop into the existing cube batches.
candidates.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)
candidates.attribution_notice: None required. The pack page states 'License Creative Commons CC0' and links the CC0 1.0 deed. A courtesy credit to kenney.nl and a row in assets/THIRD_PARTY.md are still recommended for provenance.
candidates.formats: not stated on the publisher page (page lists category 3D and 330 files); archive contents not inspected
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: not published (330 files)
candidates.integration_cost: High. Needs a model-loading path that the pinned renderer does not have (assets/vendor/three-voxel.js exports 27 symbols, no GLTFLoader/OBJLoader/TextureLoader), plus per-model footprint and collision data for the walking rules in src/world-walk.js.
candidates.unresolved_rights: Per-file terms inside the archive are unverified because nothing was downloaded; the page does not list formats, texture layout or polycounts.

candidates.package_or_version: KayKit – Forest Nature Pack, FREE tier (100+ models); publisher states 200+ unique models (1588 total with recolours) across tiers
candidates.visual_fit: Stylised low-poly trees, bushes, rocks and grass with a single 1024×1024 gradient atlas, designed to downsample to 128×128. The closest commercial-quality match to the world's flat colouring, but organic low-poly geometry rather than cubes.
candidates.license: CC0 (publisher's product page: 'Free for personal and commercial use, no attribution required. (CC0 Licensed)')
candidates.attribution_notice: None required by CC0. The publisher asks that unmodified copies not be resold and authorship not be claimed.
candidates.formats: FBX, GLTF, OBJ (stated on the product page)
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: Per-model polycounts not published. Texture atlas 1024×1024, downsampleable to 128×128. FREE tier 100+ models.
candidates.download_size: not published on the page; not measured (no download)
candidates.integration_cost: High. Textured models need an image decoder path (the bundle exposes CanvasTexture but no image loader) and a material decision against the current flat MeshLambertMaterial batches.
candidates.unresolved_rights: This pack has no GitHub licence-file distribution; only the itch product page states CC0, and the LICENSE.txt inside the free archive was not inspected. The same page sells EXTRA and SOURCE tiers — their files must not be used. Per-model polycounts unknown.

candidates.package_or_version: free_vegetation_pack.zip, uploaded 2015-01-23 by rubberduck
candidates.visual_fit: Trees (with and without leaves), bush, branch, cut trunk and mushrooms, mid-poly with LOD variants. Author describes them as 'not really low-poly, more mid-poly'. Realistic bark/leaf texturing is a different art direction from the world's flat colours, but the published triangle counts make budgeting straightforward.
candidates.license: CC0 (item page licence field 'License(s): CC0')
candidates.attribution_notice: None required by CC0. A courtesy credit 'rubberduck, OpenGameArt.org' is suggested for provenance.
candidates.formats: not listed on the item page (LOD variants mentioned; author's toolchain not stated)
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: Published triangle counts including LODs: branch 440/206/126; leafless tree 720/462/227; generated-leaf tree 880/525/321; hand-placed-leaf tree 726/476/278; cut trunk 350/159/88; bush 424/290/153; mushrooms 226–250/130–142/52 and 82/38.
candidates.download_size: 5.1 MB as reported on the item page for free_vegetation_pack.zip
candidates.integration_cost: High. Same missing-loader problem, plus a textured material path and a per-model scale/footprint decision against the 1 m grid.
candidates.unresolved_rights: File formats are not listed; the uploader is a pseudonym; the archive's own licence/credits file was not inspected (no download).

candidates.package_or_version: Terasology module PlantPack, module.txt version 1.2.2-SNAPSHOT, branch develop (inspected 2026-10-12)
candidates.visual_fit: 146 PNG block textures (bush, cactus, crop and tree families) authored for the engine's textured cube blocks. Pixel-textured faces conflict with the world's untextured flat-shaded cubes; usable only after a deliberate texture pipeline decision.
candidates.license: No licence is stated in this module repository. Its module.txt has no licence field and the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or credits file. The engine README states project artwork is 'Creative Commons Attribution License, Version 4.0 … (unless indicated otherwise - see credits for minor exceptions)' — a project-level statement that does not identify these files.
candidates.attribution_notice: Unknown per asset. A per-file attribution and credits list would have to be reconstructed and reproduced before any distribution.
candidates.formats: PNG textures, .prefab and .shape JSON metadata, module.txt
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: 146 PNG textures; pixel dimensions not measured (no download)
candidates.integration_cost: High, and not recommended. Engine-specific JSON prefabs would have to be re-authored into content/ definitions and the textures into a new material pipeline.
candidates.unresolved_rights: The per-asset licence and attribution list are unresolved. The engine's Apache-2.0 code licence does not licence these textures. Recorded as a study-only reference; do not integrate a texture from this module until its individual provenance is confirmed.
candidates.license_verified_at_url: https://github.com/MovingBlocks/Terasology/blob/develop/README.md (project-level statement only; no asset-level licence found)

candidates.package_or_version: minetest_game (Luanti) master branch; LICENSE.txt is 27,103 bytes (inspected 2026-10-12)
candidates.visual_fit: Low-resolution pixel block textures for trees, leaves, grass, dirt, wood and crops. Very poor fit: the world renders untextured flat-shaded cubes and deliberately avoids a Minecraft-like look (docs/VOXEL_WORLD.md). Recorded to document the licence route, not recommended for import.
candidates.license: Media: 'Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)' from the repository LICENSE.txt, with per-file exceptions (one item is CC BY 3.0). Source code: LGPL-2.1-or-later. The engine licence does not cover the media.
candidates.attribution_notice: Required, and non-trivial: reproduce the per-file attribution entries from LICENSE.txt for every selected texture, credit the mod authors listed in each mod's README, and mark modifications (CC BY-SA 3.0 obligations).
candidates.formats: PNG textures; .ogg sounds in the same tree
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: 16×16 pixel textures per the per-file entries
candidates.download_size: Only the 27,103-byte LICENSE.txt was fetched; the media tree was not measured.
candidates.integration_cost: Medium technically (PNG cube faces), high editorially: share-alike obligations would attach to modified derivatives, and the pixel look conflicts with the world's art direction.
candidates.unresolved_rights: The exception list was not enumerated (which files are CC BY 3.0 rather than CC BY-SA 3.0), and per-mod README author lists were not fetched. Each selected file's own entry must be read first. Share-alike effects on combined project artwork are a legal question, not an engineering one.

The repository README §License: 'We have made these icons available for you to incorporate into your products under the Apache License Version 2.0 … Feel free to remix and re-share these icons and documentation in your products.' The LICENSE file at the repository root is the Apache-2.0 text.

candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: Nominal 24×24 dp across the family; individual sizes depend on the chosen style
candidates.download_size: not measured (repository not fetched); only individual SVG files would be vendored

candidates.package_or_version: Quaternius 'Ultimate Modular Men Pack' (11 animated, textured models) — note the page slug says ultimatemodularcharacters while the displayed pack name is 'Ultimate Modular Men Pack'
candidates.visual_fit: Modular low-poly humanoids with interchangeable parts, which would suit varied resident appearances and country-ambassador avatars. Stylised low-poly rather than blocky, so it changes the world's avatar silhouette.
candidates.license: Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0, 'Last updated: 8/28/2026' — this is a custom licence, not CC0. It permits personal, educational and commercial use, modification and incorporation into a product with no credit required, and forbids reselling or redistributing 'the Assets themselves' as assets, stock files or templates (QAL §3a).
candidates.attribution_notice: None required by QAL v1.0 §2 ('No attribution is required').
candidates.formats: FBX, OBJ, Blend (product page)
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: 11 models; per-model polycounts not published
candidates.integration_cost: High: loader plus rig/animation path; modular part swapping would also need a per-resident cosmetic mapping.
candidates.unresolved_rights: Substantial. (1) The pack page shows its licence only as a badge image with no readable licence text, so the site-wide QAL v1.0 is the governing text, not a per-pack statement. (2) It is ambiguous whether serving the model files from the NemoWorld app to a browser counts as 'redistributing the Assets themselves' under QAL §3a, which would be prohibited. (3) Older third-party lists describe Quaternius packs as CC0; QAL v1.0 (2026-08-28) supersedes those claims, and no current CC0 statement could be verified. Do not integrate without written clarification or a different, clearly licensed avatar pack.

candidates.package_or_version: Terasology module ChrisVolume1OST, module.txt version 1.1.0-SNAPSHOT, branch develop; author Chris Köbke; 8 OGG tracks
candidates.visual_fit: A calm instrumental soundtrack with tracks literally named PeacefulWorld, Heaven, Sunrise-style themes suited to a peaceful shared world. This is the best-fitting ambient music candidate found, and it is also the best-documented one: the licence file sits next to the tracks.
candidates.license: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE at the repository root; read as the Apache-2.0 text on 2026-10-12). The engine's CC BY 4.0 artwork statement is not needed here because the module carries its own licence.
candidates.attribution_notice: Apache-2.0 requires the licence text and any NOTICE to be retained and distributed, and modified files to be marked. Practical form: keep the Apache-2.0 text with the vendored OGG files and credit 'Music: Chris Köbke (Chris' Terasology OST Volume 1), Apache-2.0'.
candidates.formats: OGG Vorbis (assets/music/*.ogg), plus engine .prefab JSON metadata that would be discarded
candidates.dimensions_or_polycounts: 8 tracks. Measured: PeacefulWorld.ogg 1,221,459 bytes; NightTheme.ogg 2,577,324 bytes. Durations not measured.
candidates.download_size: Individual measured files: 1,221,459 bytes and 2,577,324 bytes (raw.githubusercontent HTTP HEAD, 2026-10-12). Whole-module size not measured.
candidates.integration_cost: Medium. No audio subsystem exists in the app today (no AudioContext, no <audio> element, no src/ audio module), so playback, a user-gesture/opt-in policy and a day-phase tie-in would be new code; but bundled same-origin media is already permitted by the current CSP default-src 'self'.
candidates.unresolved_rights: The module has no NOTICE file and no README, so there is no per-track authorship breakdown beyond the module.txt author field; Apache-2.0 obligations for the tracks should be confirmed with the project before shipping. Track durations and loop points are unknown.

QAL v1.0 prohibits redistributing the assets as assets; whether web delivery of the model files counts is ambiguous. Older CC0 claims are superseded. Not integrable without clarification.

Per-file exception list and per-mod author lists not enumerated; share-alike obligations for derivative artwork are unresolved.
